body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0136 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Kerberos pre-auth failures spray (4771) - Behavior: Kerberos pre-auth failures spray (4771). Anchor is process+flag or event id+field after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated. 4771 many users one IpAddress"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0136"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1110.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "4771"
    $ip = $e.principal.ip
    $name = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $ip, $name over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $accounts = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)

  condition:
    $e and $count >= 8
}
